caption: The start page Events of Evey Events & Tickets right after the install, with a red notice Turn on Evey in your theme by October 1, 2026 (Evey isn't showing on your store yet, with the buttons Turn on Evey and Learn more) and a blue notice Select a plan when you're ready to launch (Your free trial expires in 7 days, with the button Select a plan), and the buttons Help, Settings and Create event; the store name and avatar in the bottom left corner are hidden.

The Event Settings page of the event Harbour Tour Test with the product status Active and the section Date, where the choice Recurring event is selected (This is a recurring event. Its date type can't be changed.) and a yellow notice Storefront product page scheduler is disabled with the text that the storefront integration that adds a date and time button to the product page is disabled and should be enabled for a recurring event with multiple dates and times, and a button Go to settings; the store name and avatar in the bottom left corner are hidden.

The calendar of the event with the message Schedule saved at the top and one entry on Tuesday 24 November 2026 at 15:00; the hint Double click any empty space in the calendar to add a new event is shown; the store name and avatar in the bottom left corner are hidden.

The page Change plan with the red notice Turn on Evey in your theme and the first three plan columns: Lite $0 / month plus $1.0 per ticket processed, Growth $19 / month plus $0.75 per ticket processed and Standard $49 / month plus $0.5 per ticket processed; in the Lite column Recurring events and Mailchimp and Klaviyo integrations are struck through, and in the Standard column Mailchimp and Klaviyo integrations is struck through; the store name and avatar in the bottom left corner are hidden.
